doc.name: LucidFlow BPMN validator
doc.instructions: Call validate_bpmn with the BPMN 2.0 XML text. The reply lists errors and warnings; the lucidflow block in it links to the free editor.

tools.name: validate_bpmn
tools.title: Validate a BPMN 2.0 file
tools.description: Checks a BPMN 2.0 XML file against the LucidFlow validator rules and returns the errors and warnings with their locations. Free, no account, nothing is stored. Limits: 200 KB, 1500 elements, 50 levels deep, no DOCTYPE, 2 seconds. Rate: 60 calls per minute and 1000 per day per IP address; a BPMN XML file of more than 100 KB counts for 5 calls.

xml.description: The BPMN 2.0 XML text (not a URL).
